title: Terrain Analysis
description: A bioinformatics analysis job submitted through the CyVerse Discovery Environment Terrain API.

id.description: Unique UUID identifier for the analysis

name.description: User-provided name for this analysis job

app_id.description: UUID of the application used for this analysis

system_id.description: Execution system (de for Discovery Environment, tapis for TACC)

status.description: Current execution status of the analysis

start_date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the analysis started

end_date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the analysis completed

result_folder_path.description: iRODS path where output files are stored

username.description: CyVerse username of the analysis owner
